_comment: Marma point id -> a photograph of that placement, shot from the practitioner's or the user's own point of view. SHA, 2026-09-11. A point with no entry falls back to the body map; the panel must never show a wrong picture rather than none. Wave 2 adds hands, arm, upper back, sacrum and the pelvic field sweep.
_rules: Every contact photo shows the stem touching. Every field photo shows an unmistakable gap. The light follows the spectrum by height: violet at crown and brow, cyan at throat and shoulder, rose-gold at the heart, amber and gold from the solar plexus down.

adhipati.alt: A woman in a candlelit mirror rests the stem of a tuning fork on the crown of her own head, violet rings spreading from the contact.

sthapani.alt: A man in a candlelit mirror rests the stem of a tuning fork between his own brows, violet rings spreading across the forehead.

kantha.alt: A woman in a candlelit mirror holds a tuning fork a clear hand's width in front of her own throat, not touching, a cyan field bridging the gap.

urdhva_skandha.alt: A man reaches across and presses the stem of a weighted tuning fork onto the ridge of his own shoulder, cyan rings sinking into the muscle.

hridayam.alt: A woman holds a tuning fork a clear distance in front of the centre of her own breastbone, not touching, a rose-gold field between metal and chest.

surya.alt: A woman rests the stem of a tuning fork just below her own ribs at the centre, amber rings radiating outward.

janu_anterior.alt: Looking down at her own legs, a woman rests the stem of a tuning fork on the front of her own knee, gold light branching up the thigh and down the shin.

parshni.alt: Seated with one ankle across the opposite knee, a man presses the stem of a tuning fork to the back of his own heel, gold light climbing the calf.

jatru.alt: A fork at the hollow where the collarbones meet the breastbone, the nerve pathways of the chest lit beneath.

kati.alt: A fork on the sacral plate, worked from behind, the sacral nerve fan lit across the pelvis.

krikatika.alt: A fork at the base of the skull where it meets the neck, the cervical spine and nerve tree lit beneath.

sakthi_urvi_anterior.alt: A fork on the front of the thigh, the quadriceps and its nerve pathways lit beneath the skin.

yakrut.alt: A fork under the right ribs over the liver, the organ and its nerve supply lit beneath.

shankha.alt: A fork held clear of the head beside the temple, never touching, rings of light crossing the gap into the nerve tree beneath.

_wave2: Wave 2 (SHA, 2026-09-12) — anatomical cutaways rather than first-person photographs. They teach something wave 1 could not: not just where the fork goes, but what it is reaching. Shankha was re-shot after the first version showed stem contact at the temple; it is a FIELD point, so the picture had to show the gap. It now does, and all twelve forks have a placement.
